{3: 'In the still of the night, the wet, tearing sound of something gnawing through flesh and bone travels far on the sea wind before sinking into the dark water below.'}
{3: 'The sea sways the ship on her course, and the waves sway the dreams of those aboard.'}

{3: 'Afternoon sunlight falls through the leaves, dappling the blue rippled glass table. Cotton candy and a banana split sit there, washed out like overexposed film.'}
{3: 'A clown stands farther off, gripping a tight bundle of vivid balloons like a bouquet waiting to be mailed into the heavens.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: '(Where... is this? It feels so... warm.)', 4: '18'}
{3: 'She rests in the softest embrace imaginable, held by a woman with blurred features, humming a quiet tune.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab', 2: '1', 5: '2'}
{3: 'The world dissolves into a bright, weightless swirl of color that sways with the distant melody, rising and falling like the endless surge of waves until every sense is swallowed.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: '(I know this... I know this song.)', 4: '18'}
{3: 'A song she must have heard countless times, yet it leaves no mark on her memory.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab', 5: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory844.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '0.3', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Woooo—'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: 'A low, resonant whale call cuts through the murmured lullaby, swallowing every other sound until only a sharp, piercing ring remains.'}

{3: "The frequency churns through Karenina's M.I.N.D. once again. That cold, phantom grip tightens around her heart, squeezing her very soul, relentless as a ghost. The nightmare is closing in fast."}

{3: 'Meanwhile, you are dozing at the helm when the quiet sea chart blinks with a blue alert.'}
{1: 'You have entered the designated mission area. The Balder has reached the Jormungandr node coverage zone.', 3: '50'}
{1: 'Sea Chart Alert', 2: 'You have entered the designated mission area. The Balder has reached the Jormungandr node coverage zone.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1449.jpg'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: "An unfamiliar frequency slips silently into the captain's cabin. Karenina's brow furrows as she sleeps."}
{3: 'Some long-dormant program stirs to life and begins parsing the signal, translating the droning hum into a sharp, distinct auditory feedback.'}
{3: 'The noise drives into her auditory module like a needle.'}

{3: 'The soft lullaby in her dream distorts into a vicious, grating noise.'}

{3: 'Karenina jolts awake, her chest heaving with ragged breaths.'}
{3: 'An alarm is wailing from her terminal, and she cannot tell how long it has been crying out.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}

{1: '1', 3: "The clatter of falling objects yanks you from a shallow sleep. Without hesitation, you bolt toward the captain's cabin, only a few strides away."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}

{3: "Karenina forces herself upright, but the sharp, searing pain lancing through her M.I.N.D. throws off her arm's aim, and she knocks over the bedside stand."}
{2: '(Push open the door)', 3: '128'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Ngh... my head... it hurts...', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Karenina lies curled on the bed, her hand pressed hard against her forehead in pain. The instant she hears your voice, she reaches out on pure instinct, like a frightened little animal seeking comfort.'}
{2: '(Establish M.I.N.D. connection)', 3: '136'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiLianjie1New.prefab', 2: '3'}

{3: "With the familiar M.I.N.D. connection locked in place, you exhale in quiet relief and start to carefully examine Karenina's M.I.N.D."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: 'A jagged, stabbing pain shoots through the connection between you. The ache pulses outward from your forehead, foreign and invasive.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1449.jpg'}
{3: 'The moment she feels the harm bleeding into you, Karenina wrests herself free of the agony and cuts the connection herself.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Wait... don't connect with me yet...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You'll feel it too.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She runs a quick diagnostic on herself.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Frame sync rate's off, M.I.N.D. deviation... normal. How the hell is that normal...", 4: '1'}
{2: "I'll contact the Science Council.", 3: '163'}
{3: 'It is the most standard procedure, but the moment the words leave your mouth, the reality hits: with communications still compromised, getting any help from Babylonia is nearly impossible.'}
{3: 'The last time something like this happened, it was...'}
{3: "The image of that strange mechanical potted plant, the one that soothed the anomalies in Karenina's frame, surfaces in your mind."}
{2: 'Karenina, wait here a second.', 3: '170'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: "Twenty minutes later, the captain's cabin is crammed with people."}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina sits stiffly on her bed, the mechanical potted plant clutched in her arms, looking for all the world like a young girl hugging a comfort doll after a nightmare.'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: '0v0', 4: '15'}
{3: 'The potted plant remains quiet, its indicator light breathing in and out at a steady rhythm, as if it has long accepted its role as a silent, clumsy companion.'}
{3: "Karenina's gaze moves from the worried faces of her junior crew to Lucia and Lee immersed in their diagnostics, and then settles on you with an expression of pure, sulking accusation."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '(Aaargh... they all saw me like this. Damn it, damn it, damn it!)', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "Commandant, the results match Karenina's own diagnostics. There's nothing wrong with the frame itself.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'As for the "noise"... same as the whale call from before. None of our equipment registered anything.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lucia', 3: "The root cause is in her M.I.N.D., but there's no deviation reading this time... When you initiate a connection, the protection protocols flag it immediately. But somehow, this strange plant manages to ease the symptoms...", 4: '2'}

{3: "Lucia, who arrived as soon as word reached her, retrieves the mechanical potted plant from some forgotten corner of the deck. The moment you set it beside Karenina, her frame's anomalies begin to fade."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Didn't the boss's frame take a detour through TEC territory? What if those guys messed with it?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Sensing all eyes suddenly fixed on him, Larsen freezes in place.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "I'm just a nobody here. You can watch me 24/7 if you want, but I swear I had nothing to do with this.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Screw it. I'm taking that thing apart again.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: 'Ka... Kare... reera.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: 'Crazy Sale on—', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '"Crazy"?! Are you calling me crazy?! And it\'s Karenina! NI-NA!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: '...reera. 0v0', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'NI-NA! NA! NA! NA!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: 'Ra... rara... na! 0v0', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Rarana my ass... Your name's Rarana! Your whole damn family's Rarana!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: 'Rarana. 0v0', 4: '15'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "She's screaming at a potted plant. A literal potted plant that can't even talk. And here I thought the Engineering Force was a war zone because of the vice-captain...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'Shut up. Shut up right now.', 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Lee presses his fingers to his brow, looking worn down.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'The safest move is to turn back. Take Karenina and this potted plant back to Babylonia. Get a full workup done.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Lucia's eyes move from Karenina to Lee, and she gives him a silent, negative shake."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "She's not going back.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "I can't just leave. This frame was purpose-built for marine engineering. How am I supposed to bail when things are at their worst?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Everything's on fire out here. This is exactly when the Engineering Force matters most. Some captain I'd be if I just ran.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Karenina sweeps her gaze around the room.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Besides, comms are shot. You really want to deal with calling in a return trip and scrubbing the whole mission? That's not who I am.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Balder's only escorting part of the way anyway. Final stop's the Atlantic Eye...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You don't need to worry about me. I'll make it there alone if I have to.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Karenina reels off a string of reasons in a single breath.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'But Captain... your frame still needs fixing.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "...That? It's just a little pain. Nothing I can't handle. Stop making a big deal out of nothing.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'As if sharing a single thought, Lee and Lucia turn their eyes to you.'}

{3: 'Gray Raven has faced this very situation more times than any of you can count, that fierce need to protect, no matter the danger to yourself. Every one of you understands that feeling from the inside.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "If the potted plant can ease the symptoms, we'll use it as a control variable and keep observing. We'd need to do this step anyway, even back at Babylonia.", 4: '3'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'And whether this new "noise" is connected to the "whale call" from before, we need more data before we can say anything definitive.', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "As for safety, I'll do a full teardown and inspection.", 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina hesitates for a moment, then draws a deep breath.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "No need to tear it apart. We'll just monitor it.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I already looked inside last time. It's Grandpa's work.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Not just similar. I'm pretty sure... he really made this one. I'd recognize his touch anywhere.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Then it's settled! I'll knock out these repeater replacements fast, get military comms back up, and deal with everything else after.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina turns to look at you.'}
{2: "Do what you think is best. I'm with you.", 3: '294', 4: 'Do what you think is best. I trust you.', 5: '294'}
{3: 'With a look of quiet triumph, the Construct girl lifts the mechanical potted plant.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Rarana, your sorry little life is mine now. So from here on out, you call me Boss!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mechanical Potted Plant', 3: 'Rara... na?', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You got a problem?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Rarana, boss.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Boss Karenina!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Rarana', 3: 'Kalerira—', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "AAAAAHH! I'M GONNA LOSE IT!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1589.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Sunlight sprinkles the sea with tiny shards of gold. The Balder sails steadily across the blue, its hull rocking in a slow, gentle rhythm.'}
{3: "From the highest deck, you watch the cable-laying crew's vessel at work within a two-mile spread of open water."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'Deep-dive unit has reached the designated coordinates. Captain, request permission to commence maintenance.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}

{3: "Karenina's eyes sweep across the real-time data on her terminal. She parts her lips to reply, but a sudden swell of dizziness surges through her, and the edges of her sight flare with harsh white light."}
{3: 'The world drains of color for a single second.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong03.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong03.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: 'She tightens her fingers around the communicator, silently forcing the roiling discomfort down. A few rapid blinks, and everything steadies again.'}
{3: "The crew member who looks back for Karenina's nod sees nothing out of the ordinary."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'All clear. Execute.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Ever since they pushed deeper into the central Atlantic to begin the repeater replacements, the odd disturbances in Karenina's M.I.N.D. have grown steadily more frequent."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "(Once this mission's over... I'll have Asimov give me a full checkup...)", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Karenina takes a long, steadying breath and pulls herself together.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Alphabet, pop quiz.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Huh?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You think you can swap in the second-gen quantum repeater and keep the first-gen unit intact while you're at it?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Captain... even standard protocol isn't this brutal.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Standard protocol's for standard people. The Engineering Force has its own standards. The Engineering Force is a war zone, remember?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Oh, so that's what this is about? You're terrifying, Captain...", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'I told you to shut up.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "What's the situation at the northern node?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "Northern node replacement is on track, Captain. We've got real-time confirmation. But the southern node... still nothing.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Nothing? Is their comm equipment down? Did we try shortwave? Laser?', 4: '1'}
{3: "The southern node, Fenrir, is where Mara's team is positioned."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Captain, putting it simply, we've lost contact with the southern node completely.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Given the state of the sea right now, going completely dark is an alarming omen.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'Could just be lag. Military bands have been patchy worldwide... Maybe we give it another day?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "...I don't think we have another day.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Can we pull the northern node's logs from the last few days? All anomaly reports get forwarded to Hel up north for review.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'If something went wrong in the south... it should show up there.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "I'm in the northern node's log cache now... Last timestamp from Fenrir: 28 hours ago. Status: no anomaly.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "...We'll wait a little longer.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Alphabet, signal status on the southern node every three hours. If there's anything, you tell me immediately.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Me?', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You're the one with the most free time.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTrial/FxUiTrialGet.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '3'}
{3: 'Karenina turns back and resumes monitoring the undersea repeater maintenance, her fingers idly tracing the edges of a second-generation replacement unit.'}
{3: 'On the translucent display, a 3D seabed map rotates in slow motion, with live data from the deep-dive unit scrolling in steady streams. The repeater swap progresses without issue.'}
{3: "But as the day's work winds down and the final glow of sunset sinks below the water, the comms panel for the southern node remains completely dead."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTrial/FxUiTrialGet.prefab', 5: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "I hope everything's alright... I hope...", 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1508.jpg'}
{1: 'The Southern Node', 2: 'One Day Ago'}
{2: 'Southern Node, One Day Ago.'}
{3: 'Rows of containment crates were stacked along the walls of the damp, chilled prep room.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470zhongjiqiNormal02.png'}
{3: 'Inside one of them rested a faulty first-generation repeater, just hauled up from the seabed.'}
{3: 'It had already been cleaned, labeled, and dismantled, yet the outer plating still bore stubborn traces of crimson crystalline residue, clinging like dried blood.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "Right then. Let's go over it one more time.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'Years of scientific work had ingrained in Mara the habit of checking and rechecking her data. She had never grown comfortable with the newer procedures and still relied on the clumsy, meticulous methods she had learned in her youth.'}
{3: 'The results of her reexamination largely matched what had been reported earlier.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: 'Mm... Next, the quantum decoherence spectrum from crystal degradation...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A long pause stretched before she finally spoke again.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "Log: I've identified an anomalous spike within a specific frequency band of the quantum decoherence spectrum.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The spike sat precisely at the boundary of normal fluctuation. Most researchers would have dismissed it as an acceptable margin of error.'}

{3: 'Perhaps that was why it had slipped through the initial monitoring undetected. The safety assessment system had raised no alarm. But this was not the first time Mara had seen a spike pattern like this.'}
{3: 'It was the last time Kalon had ever set foot in the Quantum Communications Research Center.'}
{1: '"This is a spike that shouldn\'t exist!"', 3: '50'}
{2: '"This is a spike that shouldn\'t exist!"'}

{3: 'Mara tidied her hair again, took a steadying breath, and pushed open the door to the laboratory.'}

{3: "Mara stared after him, dumbstruck, as he swept out of the room like a sudden gust of wind. A long moment passed before her eyes finally fell to the documents awaiting destruction. Kalon's handwriting was wild and scrawling, and she seared every word on that page into her memory."}
{3: 'The coherence time measurement curve of the quantum memory showed a spike that should never be there.'}

{3: 'Normal impurity decoherence spectra were broad and smooth, but this one showed a sharp, isolated peak, its position matching precisely the nuclear spin-flip resonance frequency of a particular isotope.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1508.jpg'}
{3: 'In the prep room of the southern node, Mara snapped back to reality.'}
{3: 'It had taken her many, many years to finally learn the name of that isotope: Ytterbium-174X3.'}
{3: 'She had been chasing that silhouette for so long, and this was a truth she had spent just as many years hunting down.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: 'Log: Anomalous readings approaching critical thresholds. Occurring at regular intervals. Extreme caution should be exercised. Assessment: System safety evaluation criteria for this category are no longer reliable.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Mara acted without delay, adjusting the parsing parameters and working to pull more pieces from the damaged log files. At last, she managed to restore a small part, recorded just before the old network went down.'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "It's been here... this long? Then... when did it start?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She needed more data to back up her instincts.'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "I'm out of time. I need something faster.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The most straightforward approach was to salvage an intact first-generation quantum repeater from the seabed and run a direct comparison.'}
{3: 'But under the current operational protocols, any repeater pulled during replacement would inevitably be broken down. Besides, they had all been heavily damaged in the crisis to begin with.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "If there's a conspiracy behind this... the damage itself is probably part of it.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'New verification protocols. Destroying evidence... The Science Council? The Cosmos Technicians Union? Which one?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470zhongjiqiNormal01.png'}
{3: "Mara's gaze settled on the second-generation quantum repeaters still waiting to be swapped."}

{3: 'She had been there for the entire journey, from the labs of the Transatlantic Economic Community to the institutes of the Cosmos Technicians Union, through every stage of the first- and second-generation repeater development.'}
{3: 'These devices, intended for global deployment, shared a common lineage: the people, the core technologies, even the materials had all come from the same roots.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "What if... that anomalous spike no one ever cared about... what if it's in the second-gen repeaters too?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'An icy dread shot up her spine and flooded her mind.'}

{3: "If her hypothesis held true, then the colossal fiber-optic network laid across the entire ocean floor, an information grid built by all of humanity's combined strength, had been carrying a fatal, unseen flaw from the very beginning."}
{3: 'Every operation currently unfolding on these waters was doing nothing more than driving that long-hidden danger deeper into the seabed.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "I keep thinking the world can't possibly get worse. And it keeps proving me wrong.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: 'The only thing it does is bump up the entangled photon decoherence rate. Just barely, still well within the theoretical margin of error. Easy to dismiss as intrinsic loss.', 4: '1'}
